stops.note: to jump, to leap, combined with in- (upon)
to jump upon, to attack, to scorn, from in- and salire
stops.meaning: to jump upon, to attack, to scorn

stops.note: settled as the English word for a disrespectful or scornful remark or action
stops.meaning: a disrespectful or scornful remark or action

current_meaning: a disrespectful, scornful remark or action, or to speak or act this way toward someone
